import ast, hashlib, subprocess, pathlib
R = pathlib.Path('/workspace')
Q = R/'python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization'
OLD, NEW = Q/'native_q8_mmq_x8_y64', Q/'native_q8_mmq_x32_y64'
def norm(s):
    return s.replace('x32_y64','x8_y64').replace('X32_Y64','X8_Y64').replace('\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 32\n','\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 8\n')
pairs = [(OLD/'mmq_x8_y64_core.cuh', NEW/'mmq_x32_y64_core.cuh'),
         (OLD/'q8_mmq_x8_y64.cu', NEW/'q8_mmq_x32_y64.cu'),
         (Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x8_y64.py', Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x32_y64.py')]
for o, n in pairs:
    assert norm(n.read_text()) == o.read_text(), 'normalized mismatch: %s' % n
ast.parse((Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x32_y64.py').read_text())
ast.parse((Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x8_y64.py').read_text())
core = (NEW/'mmq_x32_y64_core.cuh').read_text()
assert core.count('\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 32\n') == 1
assert core.count('\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 64\n') == 1 and core.count('\n#define MMQ_Y_Q8_0 128\n') == 1 and core.count('\n#define NWARPS_Q8_0 8\n') == 1
assert core.count('\n#define MMQ_Y_Q8_0 64\n') == 1 and core.count('\n#define NWARPS_Q8_0 4\n') == 1
cu = (NEW/'q8_mmq_x32_y64.cu').read_text()
assert cu.count('../native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor/') == 3
d = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'diff','--','python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gguf.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
minus = sorted(l[1:] for l in d if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---'))
plus = sorted(l[1:] for l in d if l.startswith('+') and not l.startswith('+++'))
assert len(minus) == len(plus) == 5, (minus, plus)
assert sorted(norm(p) for p in plus) == minus
V = Q/'native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor'
names = sorted(p.name for p in V.iterdir())
assert names == ['device_compat.cuh','ggml-common.h','quantize_q8_1.cuh','vecdotq.cuh'], names
for p in sorted(V.iterdir()):
    head = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'show','HEAD:python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization/native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor/'+p.name],capture_output=True).stdout
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == hashlib.sha256(head).hexdigest(), p.name
st = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
allowed = lambda l: ('native_q8_mmq_x32_y64' in l or 'gguf_q8_mmq_x32_y64.py' in l or l.endswith('python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gguf.py'))
assert st and all(allowed(l) for l in st), st
print('PASS: 3/3 token-normalized source-equal (core/.cu/helper); ast.parse both helpers; CUDA #else X32 x1 with ROCm X64/Y128/W8 and Y64/W4 intact; vendor include path x3 unchanged; seam 5 identity-only line pairs; vendor 4/4 SHA==HEAD; worktree touches only new identity+helper+seam')
